lightmap_class_scales.description: scaleInLightmap by surface class; a class left out keeps the default (roof 0.25, ground 0.5, interior 0.5, scenic 0.25, party 0.5, facade 1)

albedo_compression.description: Android format of the albedo textures the adapter imports: astc_6x6 (default), or none for uncompressed RGBA32 as before

scenic_out_of_lightmap.description: Plan C4, ADR-017 amendment (proposed): the scenic_* shell walls take no lightmap texels (scaleInLightmap 0, receiveGI LightProbes, ambient light when combined) but stay ContributeGI and cast the baked shadows; the scenic roofs stay baked. Off when absent

lightmap_pages_max.description: Plan C5, ADR-005 amendment (proposed): lightmap page budget. export package lowers lightmap_texels_per_m, in 0.25 steps and never below 4 texels/m, until the offline estimate (pages_at_least, a lower bound) fits; it refuses the package when the floor does not fit. Off when absent

lit_normal_material.description: Plan D5, ADR-033 (proposed): spike, off when absent. One facade_trim_* glTF material the adapter draws with the SDK's PP_Opaque_Lit and a tangent-space normal map that export package derives from that material's albedo (lit_normal.png). Every other material keeps PP_Opaque_Simple_Lit. The relief shows in the baked diffuse only with lightmap_directional true

lit_normal_strength.description: Plan D5, ADR-033 (proposed): relief strength of the derived normal map (slope scale of the albedo luma); 2 when absent. Needs lit_normal_material

experimental_environment.description: Plan E2, ADR-037 (proposed): a test package for the headset. Replaces the SDK time of day and post-process profile of a day gameplay layout, and sets SharedLevelSettings.SkyColor when sky_color is given. The package is marked experimental; off when absent
